title: Bind every remediation to evidence and authority
description: Choose an incident, proposed action, evidence policy, and autonomy mode. The decision gate separates a useful recommendation from permission to change production.
modelNote: The percentages and 1-5 risk values are teaching fixtures, not universal limits. Calibrate authority, scope, evidence, and rollback policy from the real service and incident history.

scenarios.label: One leaking replica
scenarios.detail: One stateless replica grows memory while peers and dependencies remain healthy.

scenarios.label: Canary release regression
scenarios.detail: The canary cohort has a higher error rate than a comparable stable control.

scenarios.label: Regional control-plane loss
scenarios.detail: A region loses a control-plane dependency while data-plane health is only partially known.

actions.label: Replace one instance
actions.detail: Drain and replace one stateless replica.

actions.label: Rollback the canary
actions.detail: Return the exposed cohort to the last qualified artifact.

actions.label: Fail over a region
actions.detail: Move regional authority and traffic to a recovery region.

actions.label: Patch the whole fleet
actions.detail: Apply a new configuration to every instance.

evidencePolicies.label: One threshold
evidencePolicies.detail: Act from one metric crossing one threshold.

evidencePolicies.label: Corroborated service evidence
evidencePolicies.detail: Combine fresh SLI, resource, topology, and change evidence.

evidencePolicies.label: Canary versus control
evidencePolicies.detail: Attribute a regression by comparing equivalent exposed and stable cohorts.

authorityModes.label: Recommend only
authorityModes.detail: The controller proposes an action; an operator owns execution.

authorityModes.label: Canary execution
authorityModes.detail: The controller may change one bounded cohort and must verify before expansion.

authorityModes.label: Bounded automatic action
authorityModes.detail: The controller may perform a pre-approved reversible action inside a narrow scope.

authorityModes.label: Unbounded fleet action
authorityModes.detail: The controller can change the whole production fleet without approval.
